title: When EVM Defaults Break: Three SDK Patterns for UTXO-Family Wallets
abstract: arXiv:2610.30183v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mainstream Web3 SDKs (e.g., ethers.js, viem) bundle three coupled assumptions: an account-based ledger, a single secp256k1 signer, and input-selection-free transaction construction. These assumptions fail once a chain adopts an extended-UTXO model (here, the Cell model on Nervos CKB), and once the wallet population spans heterogeneous cryptographic primitives (secp256k1, WebAuthn, Schnorr). Using CKBers' Codebase (CCC), a TypeScript SDK, this retrospective case study extracts three recurring patterns from release history and exported APIs: a Transaction Composer that makes capacity-aware input completion and fee estimation declarative, a Unified Signer Abstraction that normalizes signing across heterogeneous wallets behind one interface, and a Connector UI component that ships per-wallet onboarding as a drop-in. The contribution is the articulation of these patterns as transferable design lessons for SDKs targeting UTXO-family ledgers

translated_title: 当 EVM 默认假设失效时：面向 UTXO 系钱包的三种 SDK 设计模式
translated_abstract: 主流 Web3 SDK（如 ethers.js、viem）捆绑了三个相互耦合的假设：基于账户模型的账本、单一的 secp256k1 签名器，以及无需输入选择的交易构建方式。一旦某条链采用扩展 UTXO 模型（本文指 Nervos CKB 上的 Cell 模型），并且钱包群体涵盖异构的密码学原语，这些假设便会失效。本研究以 TypeScript SDK——CKBers' Codebase (CCC) 为对象，通过回溯性案例研究，从其发布历史和导出 API 中提炼出三种反复出现的模式：交易组合器，将容量感知的输入补全与手续费估算声明式化；统一签名器抽象，通过单一接口将异构钱包的签名操作规范化；连接器 UI 组件，以即插即用的方式提供针对各钱包的接入引导。本文的贡献在于将这些模式阐述为面向 UTXO 系账本的 SDK 可迁移的设计经验。
tldr: 本文以 Nervos CKB 的 TypeScript SDK（CCC）为回溯性案例，提炼出交易组合器、统一签名器抽象和连接器 UI 三种可迁移的 SDK 设计模式，以解决主流账户模型 SDK 假设在扩展 UTXO 链与异构密码学钱包环境下失效的问题。
en_tdlr: Through a retrospective case study of the CCC TypeScript SDK for Nervos CKB, this paper distills three transferable design patterns—Transaction Composer, Unified Signer Abstraction, and Connector UI—for building SDKs targeting extended-UTXO ledgers with heterogeneous cryptographic wallets.
